<?php
class AllocationBase234 { public $value = 0; public function __construct($value) { $this->value = $value; } public function capture() { echo self::class,"/",static::class,";"; return $this; } }
class AllocationScope234 extends AllocationBase234 { public static function launch() { global $owner; $a = $owner->MiSsInG((new self(1))->capture()); $b = $owner->MiSsInG((new parent(2))->capture()); $c = $owner->MiSsInG(first:(new static(3))->capture()); echo ($a->saved[0] instanceof AllocationScope234 && $a->saved[0]->value === 1 && $b->saved[0] instanceof AllocationBase234 && $b->saved[0]->value === 2 && $c->saved["first"] instanceof AllocationChild234 && $c->saved["first"]->value === 3) ? "HELD;" : "BAD;"; } } class AllocationChild234 extends AllocationScope234 {}
class ScopeMagic234 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} }; } }
$owner = new ScopeMagic234; AllocationChild234::launch(); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
function shift234() { $GLOBALS["owner"] = null; echo "SHIFT;"; return false; }
class PacketBase234 { public $saved = 0; public function __construct($value) { $this->saved = $value; echo "CTOR;"; } public function capture($ignored) { echo "METHOD;"; return $this; } public function __destruct() { echo "PACKET;"; } }
class PacketScope234 extends PacketBase234 { public static function launch() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG((new static(7))->capture(shift234())); } } class PacketChild234 extends PacketScope234 {}
class Base234 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} public function __destruct() { echo "CHILD;"; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } } class Derived234 extends Base234 {}
$owner = new Derived234; $child = PacketChild234::launch(); echo "RETURN;"; echo ($child->saved[0] instanceof PacketChild234 && $child->saved[0]->saved === 7) ? "HELD;" : "BAD;"; unset($child); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
class StaticBase234 { public function __construct() { echo "CTOR;"; } public static function capture($value) { echo "METHOD;"; return $value; } public function __destruct() { $GLOBALS["owner"] = null; echo "SELECTOR;"; throw new Exception("stop"); } }
class StaticScope234 extends StaticBase234 { public static function launch() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG((new parent)->capture(later234()),false); } } class StaticChild234 extends StaticScope234 {}
function later234() { echo "LATER;"; return 1; } class FailedMagic234 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return 9; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$owner = new FailedMagic234; $result = 0; try { $result = StaticChild234::launch(); } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CATCH;"; } echo $result === 0 ? "HELD;" : "BAD;";

<?php
class EmptyBase234 { public function value() { return true; } public static function marker() { return false; } }
class EmptyScope234 extends EmptyBase234 { public static function launch() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG(first:(new self)->value(),later:(new parent)->marker()); } } class EmptyChild234 extends EmptyScope234 {}
class EmptyMagic234 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo ($arguments["first"] === true && $arguments["later"] === false) ? "HELD;" : "BAD;"; return 9; } }
$owner = new EmptyMagic234; $result = EmptyChild234::launch(); echo $result === 9 ? "OK;" : "BAD;";
